description: Query statistical data from a CBS Netherlands table using OData filters. Supports $filter (e.g. "Perioden eq '2023JJ00'" for annual 2023, "RegioS eq 'NL00  '" for national), $select (specific columns), $top (max 100 records), and $skip (pagination). Returns typed data rows with all dimension and topic values. Use table_properties first to discover available columns and valid filter values. Annual period codes use format YYYY + JJ00 (e.g. 2023JJ00). Source: opendata.cbs.nl — CC BY 4.0, no auth, unlimited free access.

filter.description: OData $filter expression to narrow results (e.g. "Perioden eq '2023JJ00'" for annual 2023 data, or "RegioS eq 'NL00  '" for national totals). Use values from the table's dimension endpoints.

limit.description: Number of data records to return (1–100, default 10).

select.description: Comma-separated list of columns to include (e.g. "Perioden, RegioS, Bevolking_1"). Reduces response size for wide tables. Omit to return all columns.

skip.description: Number of records to skip for pagination (default 0).

table_id.description: CBS table identifier (e.g. "83583NED"). Use catalog_search to find a table, then table_properties to discover its columns.

name: cbs.table.data

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: CBS Netherlands Table Data
